llm.answer:
**Core Graphics – Apple Developer Documentation (PDF)** *The following points capture the main ideas that appear in the three pages of the PDF you provided.* | Topic | Key Points | Source | |-------|------------|--------| | **What Core Graphics is** | • A low‑level, lightweight 2‑D rendering engine built on Quartz.
• Delivers high‑fidelity output for a wide range of graphics tasks. | [Source 1] | | **Primary responsibilities** | • Path‑based drawing, transformations, and anti‑aliasing.
• Color management, gradients, patterns, and shadings.
• Off‑screen rendering, image data handling, image creation, and masking.
• PDF document creation, display, and parsing. | [Source 1] | | **macOS‑specific services** | • Direct access to display‑hardware features via Quartz Display Services.
• Low‑level user‑input event handling through Quartz Event Services.
• Window‑management information via Quartz Window Services. | [Source 1] | | **Core data types** | • `CGFloat` – basic floating‑point scalar.
• `CGPoint`, `CGSize`, `CGRect` – geometric primitives.
• `CGVector`, `CGAffineTransform` – vector and transform helpers. | [Source 1] | | **Core graphics objects (classes & structs)** | • **Drawing context** – `CGContext` (Quartz 2D drawing environment).
• **Images** – `CGImage`, `CGImageMask`, `CGLayer` (off‑screen reusable content).
• **Paths** – `CGPath` (immutable) and `CGMutablePath` (mutable).
• **Colors** – `CGColor`, `CGColorSpace`, `CGColorConversionInfo`.
• **Fonts** – `CGFont` (glyphs & layout).
• **PDF** – `CGPDFDocument`, `CGPDFMarkedContentItem`, `CGPDFStructureElement`.
• **Data** – `CGDataConsumer` (write abstraction), `CGDataProvider` (read abstraction).
• **Gradients & shading** – `CGGradient`, `CGShading`, `CGPattern`.
• **Functions** – `CGFunction` (callback‑based). | [Source 1] | | **Enumerations & constants** | • Types such as `CGImageComponent`, `CGColorModel`, `CGBitmapLayout`, `CGComponent`, `CGContentToneMappingInfo`, `CGImageComponentInfo`. | [Source 3] | | **Utility & support** | • `CGRenderingBufferProvider` and `CGBitmapParameters` for low‑level buffer handling.
• `CGPDFMarkedContentItem` and `CGPDFStructureElement` for PDF content hierarchy. | [Source 3] | | **Documentation structure** | • The PDF is organized into sections: “Core Graphics”, “Quartz 2‑D Programming Guide”, “Related Documentation”, etc. | [Source 2] | ### Take‑away Core Graphics is the foundational 2‑D rendering engine on Apple platforms. It exposes a rich set of geometric types, drawing primitives, image and PDF handling classes, and low‑level services for display, event, and window management. The framework is designed for performance and fidelity, making it suitable for everything from simple UI drawing to complex PDF generation and manipulation.
